facts.fact: A Lagos man verified his National Identification Number (NIN) and account on the NPC's VitalReg birth-registration platform before reaching the Birth Section, as he told FIJ.

NGA.note: The document states no exchange of records between the civil register and the ID system.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is stated.
No ID number given at birth is stated.
Nothing is stated about who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the NIN is stated.

facts.fact: The man told FIJ his first daughter has a National Identification Number (NIN), so the system has issued a number to her.
